extDesc.message: New Google Play orders and refunds, pushed to Telegram. No server, no account, no SDK.

hintBotToken.message: Create a bot with /newbot in @BotFather and paste the token it gives you.

hintChatId.message: Send your bot any message first, then press Find chat ID.

hintSender.message: Prefixed to every message. Useful when one chat receives alerts from several sources. Leave empty to omit.

hintConsoleUrl.message: Open Play Console → Orders and paste the address. The developer ID is read from it.

hintPackages.message: Comma-separated package names, e.g. com.example.one, com.example.two. Leave empty for all apps.

hintMinPayout.message: Skip orders paying out less than this. Set 1 to hide zero-value test orders. 0 notifies everything.

lblShowLocal.message: Show time in your local zone

hintTimes.message: Play records order times in UTC. Turn both on to see them side by side.

hintInterval.message: Only runs while Chrome is open, using your signed-in Play Console session.

hintDays.message: How far back each check reads. Two days is enough unless Chrome is closed for long stretches.

lblVerbose.message: Send every check result to Telegram

hintVerbose.message: For confirming it is alive. Turn it off once you trust it.

msgBadToken.message: That does not look like a bot token. Paste the whole "digits:letters" string from @BotFather.

msgBadUrl.message: Could not find a developer ID in that URL. It should look like https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/1234567890/orders

msgNoChat.message:
No conversation found.
1. Open your bot in Telegram and press Start, or send it any message.
2. Press this button again.
(Messages older than 24 hours are not returned.)

msgChatFilled.message:
$1

Filled in the first one. Press Save.

msgUnauthorized.message: The token was rejected. Check it again in @BotFather → /mybots.

msgResetDone.message: History cleared. The next check will re-sync without notifying.

msgNoBackground.message:
The background service did not respond.
Reload the extension in chrome://extensions, then close and reopen this page.

msgNeedSetup.message: Enter a bot token and chat ID, then press Save.

statusNoAlarm.message: No schedule registered. Press Save to set it.

resultFirst.message: First sync: recorded $1 orders without notifying.

tgFirstSync.message: Kaching started. Recorded $1 orders from the last $2 days. Only new ones will be announced from now on.

tgFailAuth.message: Your Play Console session expired. Sign in again in this browser.

hintLog.message: The most recent $1 events, newest first. Kept on this machine only.

logFirstSync.message: First sync — recorded $1 orders without notifying

hintDailyTotal.message: Adds a footer to every order message with what the day has announced so far. The bot answers /today and /month either way; this only controls the footer.

cmdHelp.message: Send /today, /week or /month for a running total. /recount works a day out again from Play; /adjust corrects one by hand.

totalRecountUntouched.message: nothing announced for that day, so it was left alone

cmdAdjust.message: Correct a day's total by an amount, + or -

cmdAdjustUsage.message: Send an amount with it: /adjust -6500, or /adjust 2026-08-20 -6500 for an earlier day. In $1.

cmdRecount.message: Work a day out again from Play, by charge date

cmdRecountUsage.message: That day is outside what Play will return here. Try /recount or /recount with a day inside the last $1.

logMenuFail.message: Could not register the bot command menu ($1)

hintBreakdown.message: Adds a line with the tax withheld and, once Play reports enough to work it out, the exact rate of Google's cut — so the estimated net can be checked rather than trusted.
